summary: The latest Parquet Java 1.18.2 release fixes several critical bugs on the 1.18.x branch, including writer failures, dictionary lookup collisions, and Bloom filter issues. Meanwhile, the community is discussing a new logical type, VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR), to represent fixed‑length numeric vectors with constraints such as non‑null and finite values.

highlights.text: Apache Parquet Java 1.18.2 release includes critical fixes for writer failures, dictionary lookup collisions, and Bloom filter problems on the 1.18.x branch.
A discussion proposes adding a logical type VECTOR (or FINITE_VECTOR) to represent fixed‑length numeric vectors and enforce non‑null and finite constraints.

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)
